steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password exactly as that text; it is filled in when typed). Then go to the repository bench/bench-repo, open its Issues tab, and report the titles of the OPEN issues whose titles start with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed on the page.

02-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with the title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' somewhere in it (e.g. a sentence mentioning {{runid}}). Submit it, and report the issue number exactly as the app displays it (Gitea shows it as #<number>) and the title shown on the resulting issue page.

03-open: Open {{02-create.url}} and report exactly which labels are currently displayed on the issue page (in the sidebar and/or label list). Do not change anything — just read and report the label names shown, or say 'no labels' if none are displayed.

04-add: On the issue page {{02-create.url}}, the issue currently has the label '{{03-open.applied_label_link}}'. Add the label 'priority-high' to it using the Labels picker in the issue sidebar. The picker is a dropdown menu listing available labels with checkboxes — open it, tick/select the 'priority-high' entry, then close the menu (click elsewhere or press Escape) so Gitea saves the change. The goal is that the issue page ends up displaying BOTH labels '{{03-open.applied_label_link}}' and 'priority-high' on the issue itself (not just ticked inside the open menu). If clicking the menu item does not apply it, try alternatives such as keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter) or clicking the item's checkbox/label element. Verify at the end by reading the sidebar label list, and report the labels displayed. Do not remove the '{{03-open.applied_label_link}}' label.
